title: Virtual screens
setup.text: Installs Sunshine and lets devices reach this laptop over USB tethering. Wi-Fi stays closed until you allow a network. Asks for your password once.
wifi.allowed: Devices on this Wi-Fi can connect
details.off: Turn it on to connect a device.
details.noConnection: No connection yet: turn on USB tethering on the device, or allow this Wi-Fi above.
details.typePin: Then type the PIN Moonlight shows:
details.pairDifferentHint: For using another device instead of this one. For its own screen, use %1.
